newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's BCI 1996 net profits hold steady.
newsitem.headline: Italy's BCI 1996 net profits hold steady.

text.p: Italian bank Banca Commerciale Italiana (BCI) said on Wednesday its parent net profit for 1996 was almost unchanged from the previous year, although its net operating profit rose 17 percent.
BCI said in statement the full year net profit reached 341 billion lire ($203 million), barely changed from 342.3 billion registered in 1995.
The bank said it planned to raise its dividend to 165 lire per ordinary share from 150 previously and increase the savings dividend to 195 from 180.

"Despite the harsh conditions characterising banking activities, net interest income improved, reaching 3.09 trillion or up 1.6 percent due to a rise in income from dividends in investment stakes and the higher volume of client loans," it said.
Total deposits rose 13.6 trillion lire to 121.4 trillion while total loans rose 11.6 percent to 107.3 trillion.
BCI's board had also approved the outline of a plan to recapitalise its French operation, BCI France, "to allow it to reposition itself on the French corporate banking market."
